title: ASK ME ANYTHING: A SIMPLE STRATEGY FOR PROMPTING LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the frequencies of specific target tokens (e.g., 'yes' vs. 'no', 'True' vs. 'False') in the language model's pretraining corpus (The Pile) to demonstrate how data imbalances bias the model towards certain restricted answer choices in zero-shot and few-shot prompting.
